name: SHIVAM VERMA

experiences.description: Architected and shipped a complete advertisement pipeline across three microservices, including database schema design, REST APIs, and VAST 3.0/4.2 skipoffset generation supporting both single and podded ad breaks. Integrated pre-, mid-, and post-roll advertisements for DRM-protected live streams using Google IMA SDK, VMAP, and ExoPlayer (Media3); implemented centralized ad gating, ad-tag generation, and playback controls. Built a dual-tier PPV purchasing flow (subscribed/unsubscribed pricing) with Cashfree payment integration for Android live streams; integrated with backend APIs and resolved a client-side pricing issue by refetching stream details after purchase. Resolved critical production crashes and stability issues; contributed to features shipped on the Google Play Store application Home Cinema Plus.

Designed and developed secure REST APIs using Spring Boot with JWT authentication and role-based access control. Built AI-powered roadmap generation and content summarization features using LLM APIs. Developed a LangGraph-based chatbot with FAISS vector search and session-aware conversations. Wrote unit and integration tests using JUnit and validated APIs using Postman. Contributed to backend features for Sagenest, an AI-powered platform.

Developed backend services using FastAPI for AI-powered legal document retrieval. Built document retrieval and summarization pipelines using LangChain, FAISS and LLMs. Implemented multi-turn conversational legal chatbots with contextual question answering. Containerized backend services using Docker.
Designed Android UI screens using XML layouts from Figma designs.

projects: Yournal – Built an offline journaling and task management application using Jetpack Compose and Room Database following MVVM architecture. Tech Stack: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room, MVVM.
E-Shop – Developed an e-commerce Android application with Firebase Authentication, Razorpay integration and Room-based offline storage. Tech Stack: Kotlin, Firebase, Razorpay, Coroutines, Room.
